calls.statement:
SELECT member_id, member_key, join_date, tier, home_store_id, valid_from, valid_to, is_current
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
ORDER BY join_date, member_id, valid_from

WITH v AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS rows_on_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS distinct_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE vn = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS first_version_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) > 1)) AS ids_with_multi_join_dates,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v WHERE vn = 1 AND valid_from <> join_date) AS first_version_validfrom_ne_join,
  (SELECT MAX(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join,
  (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
  (SELECT MAX(join_date) FROM stg_member_updates) AS stg_max_join

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS stg_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE s.join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND s.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS stg_not_in_dim,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM stg_member_updates)) AS dim_not_in_stg,
  (SELECT CAST(AVG(c) AS DECIMAL(6,1)) FROM (SELECT join_date, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) c FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-10-02' GROUP BY 1)) AS avg_daily_sep,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)) AS multiversion_members,
  (SELECT string_agg(fiscal_period_label || ' ' || CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR), '; ') FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_start_date <= DATE '2026-10-03' AND period_end_date >= DATE '2026-10-03') AS period_loaded

calls.statement:
SELECT m.join_date, dayname(m.join_date) AS dow, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date = m.join_date) AS receipts
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-12' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
